label: 19–23 October
notes: Cook in this order: fish and prawns first while they're freshest.
Breakfast is the same every day. Prep the jars the night before.
4, 5 and breakfast show the exact amounts for each step in cook mode.
Nutrition is estimated per serving from ingredient weights.

breakfast.title: Berry, chia & almond protein yoghurt bowl

steps.text: Night before (best): put 170g yoghurt in each of 2 jars or bowls. Stir 30g oats and 10g chia into each, then top each with 80g frozen berries. Lid on and into the fridge: the berries thaw into a sauce overnight.
Same-morning option: microwave the 160g berries in a bowl for 60–90 sec until thawed. Stir the oats and chia into the yoghurt and leave for 3 min to soften, then top with the berries.
Top each bowl with 10g chopped almonds. No salt or sugar needed.

breakfast.tip: Make 3 jars on Sunday night, then 2 more when they run out. The oats soften and the chia thickens it, so it's grab-and-go.

dinners.title: Honey-tamari salmon, rice, tenderstem & edamame

ingredients.item: Tilda basmati, dry. Half is for 2

steps: Rinse 200g rice and simmer in plenty of water for 11 min, then drain. Keep half for tonight. Spread the other half on a plate to cool, then refrigerate within 1 hour for 2.
Mix the tamari, honey and garlic.
Air Fryer: salmon skin-side down at 200°C for 9–10 min. Brush with half the glaze at 5 min.
Boil the tenderstem for 4 min, adding the edamame for the last 2 min. Drain.
Serve the salmon on the rice with the greens. Spoon over the rest of the glaze and finish with spring onion and a squeeze of lime.
dinners.tip: Weigh the rice dry. 50g dry per person is what keeps this under 600 kcal.

dinners.title: Chilli-lime prawn burrito bowls
steps: Toss the prawns with the oil, paprika, cumin, chilli, the zest of 1 lime and a pinch of salt.
Air Fryer: 200°C for 6–7 min, shaking halfway, until pink all through.
Salsa: chop the tomatoes, onion and half the coriander. Mix with the juice of ½ lime and a pinch of salt.
Reheat the rice with a splash of water for 2 min, until piping hot. Warm the beans with a pinch of cumin.
Build the bowls: rice, beans, shredded lettuce, prawns, salsa, sliced avocado, a spoon of yoghurt and lime wedges.
dinners.tip: Freeze the other half tin of beans in a small box, ready for another bowl.

dinners.title: Chicken shawarma quinoa bowls with garlic-mint yoghurt
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer it in 200ml water, covered, for 12–15 min. Rest it off the heat.
Toss the chicken with half the oil, the spices, a squeeze of lemon and salt. Toss the peppers and onion with the rest of the oil.
Air Fryer: veg at 200°C for 8 min, then add the chicken and cook for 14–16 min more, turning halfway, until cooked through.
Sauce: yoghurt, grated garlic, chopped mint and a pinch of salt. Salad: dice the cucumber and tomatoes and dress with lemon and salt.
Slice the chicken and build the bowls: quinoa, veg, chicken, salad and a spoon of sauce.
dinners.tip: Keep the rest of the mint wrapped in damp kitchen roll for 5.

dinners.title: Italian beef & lentil stuffed aubergine

ingredients.item: lean beef mince 5% (defrosted overnight in the fridge)

steps.text: Air Fryer: halve the aubergine lengthways and score the flesh in a 2cm criss-cross, 1cm deep. Brush the cut sides with 1 tsp oil and sprinkle with ¼ tsp salt. Air fry cut-side up at 190°C for 15 min, until the flesh is soft when poked.
Meanwhile, heat 1 tsp oil in a large frying pan on high for 1 min. Add the mince and break it up with a spoon. Cook for 5 min, stirring, until browned with no pink left.
Turn to medium. Add the onion and pepper and cook for 4 min, stirring now and then, until the onion turns soft and see-through.
Stir in the garlic, oregano, chilli flakes and tomato paste. Cook for 1 min, stirring so the paste doesn't catch.

Add the tomatoes, lentils, 200ml water, ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper. Bring to a bubble, put a lid on and simmer on low for 20 min, stirring every 5 min. It's ready when the lentils are soft and a spoon dragged through the sauce leaves a trail. If it gets dry, add 50ml water.
Scoop the flesh out of the aubergine halves, leaving a 1cm wall. Chop the flesh and stir it into the ragù for 1 min.
Taste the ragù. If it tastes flat, add ¼ tsp salt. If it's too sharp, stir in ½ tsp honey.
Air Fryer: fill the aubergine halves with the ragù and cook at 190°C for 5 min, until the top sizzles. Serve any extra ragù on the side.

dinners.tip: The tomatoes and paste need the salt here. Unlike the Asian dishes there's no tamari or fish sauce to season it.

dinners.title: Lemongrass chicken bún with herbs & nuoc cham

steps.text: Mix the chicken with the lemongrass paste, tamari, 1 tsp honey, 1 tsp oil and ¼ tsp black pepper. Don't add salt: the tamari and lemongrass paste season it. Leave for 10 min.
Air Fryer: spread the chicken out in one layer and cook at 200°C for 14–16 min, shaking halfway. It's done when the edges are charred and the inside reaches 75°C, or the juices run clear.

Boil 1.5 litres water. Take it off the heat, add the vermicelli and soak for 5 min (or as the pack says). Drain, rinse under cold water for 30 sec and shake dry. No salt needed: the dressing seasons the noodles.
Nuoc cham: in a jar, stir the fish sauce, lime juice, 1 tsp honey, garlic, chilli flakes and 45ml cold water until the honey dissolves.
Cut the carrot and cucumber into 5cm matchsticks. Slice the lettuce into 1cm ribbons, pick the herb leaves and chop the almonds.
Taste the nuoc cham. It should be salty, sour and slightly sweet. If too salty, add 1 tbsp water. If flat, add ½ tsp fish sauce. If too sharp, add ½ tsp honey.
Build each bowl: noodles, veg, herbs, chicken and almonds. Spoon 2 tbsp nuoc cham over each and serve the rest on the side.

dinners.tip: Take the chicken out of the freezer the day before and defrost it in the fridge.

tips: Split the chicken thighs into 2 × 300g. Fridge one for 3 (check the use-by; freeze it too if it ends before you'll cook 3). Freeze the other for 5.
Freeze all the beef mince: one 300g bag for 4 and 3 × 150g bags for future weeks. Label them.
Cook 200g rice once. Half is for 2: fridge it within an hour of cooking and reheat it once only, until piping hot.
Wrap the coriander and mint in damp kitchen roll in a box. They're used in 2, 3 and 5.
Move the 300g mince for 4 from the freezer to the fridge.
Move the chicken for 5 from the freezer to the fridge.

prep.when: When the breakfast jars run out

tips: Edamame: 80g goes in 1. The rest of the bag is a snack: microwave it and add ¼ tsp salt.
Little gems: one in 2, one in 5. Cucumber: half in 3, half in 5. Limes: 1, 2 and 5.
Freeze the leftover half tin of black beans. The spare pepper and cherry tomatoes make a snack with Babybel.
Lentils, quinoa, chopped tomatoes, tomato paste and fish sauce all come from your cupboard.
